sentence: This project studies how antigen-specific T cells contribute to acute kidney injury after cancer immunotherapy, using animal models.
This project studies which proteins misfold when cells shrink under hypertonic exposure and how cells cope with that stress.
This project studies the molecular genetic processes, cell signaling and metabolism that help tumors start, spread and come back.
This project builds a therapy for chronic inflammation from synthetic nanoassemblies of galectin-1 and galectin-3, which are carbohydrate-binding proteins.
This project uses Drosophila neural stem cells to study what controls the number and types of neurons that form during development.
This project focuses on how to prevent cancer and deliver high quality care to patients with cancer.
This project studies how quiescent cells change their gene expression and cell biology, and how copy number variation changes and what it does.
This project studies how immune dysregulation arises and leads to autoimmunity and inflammation.
This project studies how blood vessels control the activity of human bone marrow-derived stem cells that can regenerate bone.
This project runs laboratory tests on specimens from children and adults with chronic kidney disease to learn how the disease progresses.
This project studies how a signal made inside tumor cells helps melanoma start and grow in mice.
This project provides molecular biology and cell biology tools and services, such as sequencing and microscopy, to researchers.
This project builds two models to study why leukemia comes back after cellular therapy.
This project focuses on cancer care delivery research to improve the care experience for patients with cancer.
This project tests whether drugs can reverse fibrosis after radiation in head and neck cancer patients, and builds deep learning methods to measure it.
This project studies which tissues and processes in females are affected by phthalates in metabolism and reproduction.
This project studies how neural circuits in the striatum encode cues linked to alcohol and how long-term alcohol exposure changes them.
This project describes many zebrafish models of human cognitive disorders using CRISPR, sequencing, imaging and behavioral assays.
This project builds tools that give surgeons real-time feedback on how much force they use during robotic hernia repair surgery.
This project tests whether a protein that itaconate targets is what lets itaconate switch off macrophage activity.
